title: Handoff gate waivers
description: The waiver file read by scripts/check_handoff_gate.py --waivers. A waiver is the gate's only exit: it moves one named clause from FAIL to WAIVED, and WAIVED is never PASS. This schema is the published contract; the gate enforces the same rules in code, and a drift test pins the two together. Any invalid entry voids the whole file rather than being dropped on its own, so a file its author clearly got wrong can never move the verdict.

waivers.description: Whole-clause waivers. v1 is whole-clause only: there is no per-finding waiver, because findings carry no stable codes.

clause.description: The clause being waived. Must be a member of CLAUSE_NAMES in check_handoff_gate.py; a waiver naming anything else is refused.

reason.description: Why this clause is excused, recorded for the audit trail and printed in the gate's report. A blank or whitespace-only reason is refused: a reasonless waiver is an auto-accept, which turns an unsatisfied rule into a permanent pass.
